normalized_matching_profile.description: SummaryLocated in the charming Magnolia Cottages by the Sea community, Driftwood Place is a newly renovated 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom beach cottage designed for relaxation. This stylish retreat is just a short walk to deeded beach access and the heated community pool. With an open-concept layout, a spacious screened porch, and a new master suite with a private sitting area and morning kitchen, this home is perfect for families and groups of up to 8 guests. Two bikes, a charcoal grill, and beach essentials are provided for effortless days by the shore.SpaceDriftwood Place has recently undergone some significant improvements which have included a new master suite with sitting room/office space, morning kitchen and a complete renovation of all bathrooms! Nestled in the tranquil community of Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, Driftwood Place offers an ideal retreat for those seeking peace, relaxation, and a place to reset. Located just off scenic Highway 30A, this serene beach house is a short, scenic walk to deeded beach access and one block from the heated (winter-spring) community pool. Designed to sleep up to 8 guests, Driftwood Place combines spaciousness with a cozy charm, featuring an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area perfect for gathering with loved ones. Unwind in the newly added master suite, a true haven that includes a private sitting area, work desk (for those who need a quiet corner to stay connected), and a morning kitchen for the perfect start to each day. Each of the three bathrooms has been tastefully renovated with soothing, modern finishes, including fresh tile, glass shower enclosures, and sleek chrome fixtures. Start your mornings on the large screened porch, breathing in the ocean air with a cup of coffee, or end your evenings under the stars. Driftwood Place provides two bicycles, a charcoal grill, and beach essentials, including chairs, a wagon, and beach toys for effortless days by the shore. When the spirit of exploration calls, step out onto the 18-mile Timpoochee Trail, where you can walk, bike, or jog along 30A, discovering charming communities, local shops, and inviting restaurants. Whether you’re here to unwind, reset, or reconnect, DRIFTWOOD PLACE is your peaceful home away from home. Come find your quiet space on 30A. TRANSPORTATION - Biking is a popular mode of transportation! This home has 2 bikes for your use. Should you require more during your stay, a discount code to a local bike shop will be provided with your arrival information. HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Large heated (Winter months) resort style pool - Easy walk to beach access - Easy walk to Timpoochee Trail BEACH ACCESS/SERVICE: - There is deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood. - In order to sit near the access, you must rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) otherwise you may use the access and walk 2 minutes to the right or 4 minutes to the left to the public access. - Beach Service is provided by two local vendors; information provided upon request SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 8) - Primary Suite - 2nd Floor: King bed, NEW private bathroom with walk-in shower and sitting area with morning kitchen - King Bedroom - 1st floor: King bed, NEW private bathroom with walk-in shower - Bunk Room - 1st floor: 2 sets of twin-over-twin bunks, New bathroom with walk-in shower FEATURES: - New primary suite and bathrooms - 3 Bedroom/3 Bathroom Cottage- Sleeps 8 - 2 Adult Bikes - Work space - Private large screened porch off living/dining area - Full Sized Washer Dryer - Fully Appointed Kitchen - Full Size - appliances - Charcoal Grill - Complimentary Wifi - Large HEATED (Winter) Community Pool only steps away - Parking for 2 cars in driveway - Close Proximity to the beach - neighborhood is directly across 30A from beach access - 18 Mile Bike Path along 30A - Close to The Big Chill, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and Seaside - The outdoor shed houses amenities for your use - beach chairs, wagons, toys and a cooler. NeighborhoodMagnolia Cottages by the Sea is a quaint neighborhood along 30A between Rosemary/Alys and Seagrove/Seaside. Walkable to many places, easy bike ride to more, and a short car ride to any and everything you need!TransitSee above - foot, bike or a short car ride!House Rules1. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the Rental Property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged to guests if smoking inside Rental Property occurs or evidence is found of smoking inside. 2. People other than included in the Guest Count may not stay in the property. Any other person on Rental Property is the sole responsibility of Guest. 3. Quiet Hours are 10pm – 8am. Excessive noise inside these hours are not permitted and will result in eviction and cancellation with no refund. 4. Rental Property is privately owned; Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for any accidents, injuries or illness that occurs while on the Rental Property or its facilities. The Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for the loss of personal belongings or valuables of the Guest and Rental Party. By accepting this reservation, it is agreed that Guests and Rental Party are expressly assuming the risk of any harm arising from their use of the Rental Property or others whom they invite to use the Rental Property. 5. Guest agrees to keep the property and all furnishings in good order and only use appliances for their intended uses. 6. Pets are not allowed. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged and Guest will be evicted. 7. Housekeeping: There is no daily housekeeping service. While linens and bath towels are included in the unit, daily maid service is not included in the rental rate. We do not permit towels or linens to be taken from the property unless used for amenities outside the property such as shared hot tub and pool areas. Please return the linens in the Property after use. 8. Water and Septic: The septic system is very effective; however, it will clog up if improper material is flushed. DO NOT FLUSH anything other than toilet paper. No feminine products should be flushed at any time. If it is found that feminine products have been flushed and clog the septic system, you will be charged for any damages incurred by Property Manager or Owner. 9. Renter(s) are responsible for themselves, their family and guests at all times. Children should be supervised at all times. 10. If Rental Party exceeds the maximum occupancy Guest will be asked to leave the Rental Property with no refunds. Infants under 2 years are not counted. 11. At least one parent or adult must be present at all times when children under the age of 16 are in the Rental Property or using any of outdoor facilities such as Hot Tub. 12. Owner/Property Manager is not responsible for money, jewelry, or other valuables lost, stolen, or left behind in the Rental Property, but will use their best effort to remedy the situation. 13. No rowdy behavior is permitted. Guests must behave at all times, in a reasonable and proper manner and act in a way as to protect the Rental Property, its contents and furnishings against damage. Failure to do so could result in eviction. 14. No subletting of the Rental Property or assigning of this agreement is permitted. 15. Please note that we charge per guest after a set number. Please provide the entire group count in your reservation request. If an update to the group count is needed after confirming the reservation, the reservation cost may increase. 16. Guest must obtain approval prior to checking in early or check out late. If Guest enter the Rental Property before agreed upon Check In Time or leave the Rental Property after agreed upon Check Out Time, Guest will be charged $50/half hour. 17. Guest is responsible to learn and understand any mandates, restrictions or public health orders relating to COVID-19 before confirming a reservation. 18. Guest agrees that they are 25 years of age or older. 19. If applicable, Guest may be responsible for loss of any parking passes/permits in amounts up to $400 per pass/permit. 20. Emotional Support Animals (ESA) are not allowed unless explicitly approved by Owner/Manager. If violated, a $500 fee will be charged to the Guest and Guest will be evicted. 21. Bicycles must yield to pedestrians when riding on sidewalks. Use designated crosswalks and follow all traffic laws. 22. Helmets are required for riders under 16. Nighttime riding requires a front light and rear reflectors for visibility. 23. Only licensed and insured drivers may operate golf carts and low-speed vehicles (LSVs). 24. Golf carts and LSVs must follow Florida motor vehicle laws and may only be driven on roads with speed limits of 35 mph or less. 25. Golf carts and LSVs may not be driven on sidewalks or bike paths. Working headlights and taillights are required for nighttime use. 26. Bicycles must be locked when parked and marked with identification for return. Guests are responsible for any loss, theft, or damage during the rental. 27. Golf cart and LSV drivers must ensure all passengers wear seatbelts and do not exceed passenger limits. 28. Reckless driving or unauthorized modifications to golf carts and LSVs is prohibited. Park responsibly and return vehicles clean and fully charged or refueled. 29. LSVs and bicycles are not allowed within the Rosemary Beach Community. 30. Guests are responsible for any fines, tickets, or damages incurred during use. Bicycles and golf carts/LSVs must be returned in the same condition as provided. 31. Guests acknowledge the inherent risks of using bicycles and operating golf carts/LSVs. 32. Guests agree to indemnify and hold harmless LocalVR, its owners, and employees from any claims or damages arising from use. 33. LocalVR and the property owner are not liable for injuries or damages incurred, except in cases of gross negligence or willful misconduct.Read Less
